job.purpose: Static SM x-load, streaming block-dot emission (H-ELEM-A r2 2026-10-15): the double-buffered block-dot lane store (4 x 64 x 266 = 68,096 flops on one root) is replaced by a 16-slot lane ring per t-parity (slot {p[0], j}, 2 x 16 x 266 = 8,512 flops); beat pair b of tpair k leaves at the fixed edge E(k,b) = max(k WB + n(b), E_prev + 2) (n(b) = lanes starting below bit 2048(b+1)), the recurrence of tools/hbm_sm_xload_static_timing.py, checked beat-by-beat by the lock bench; every x-store write identical to the production x-load; 4..26 edges earlier per command, same VM read-group calendar (WB windows unchanged).
